name: 22812 · Bridgewater, VA
findings: ZIP 22812 (Bridgewater) has 36 nonprofit organizations. 14 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 13 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (50% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 22812 (Bridgewater) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
